missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Трава' is feminine and stays nominative as the subject of 'становится'. 'Весной' is an instrumental time word, and 'зелёной' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Траву' is the accusative direct object of 'скосил', taking the -у ending of first-declension feminine nouns. 'Во дворе' names the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'много'. 'Травы' is genitive of quantity after 'много'. 'Зелёной' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'на поле' is prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Траве' is dative after 'к' showing movement toward the grass. 'Свежей' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'корова' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Травой' is instrumental describing what covers the field. 'Высокой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, a natural passive description.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Траве' takes the prepositional form after 'на' to mean lying on the grass. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Травы' is genitive after 'нет' to express absence. 'В саду' is prepositional, a clean model of negated existence.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Травы' is the nominative plural subject of 'качаются', here meaning grasses or wild plants. 'Высокие' agrees, and 'на ветру' is prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Траве' is prepositional after 'на', the surface where dew shines. 'Роса' is the nominative subject, and 'утром' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Траве' is prepositional after 'в' to mean hidden in the grass. 'Густой' agrees in the feminine prepositional case.
